Name: TAO Group Hospitality
Area of interest: Tao Group Hospitality Cares strives to make a positive impact on the communities Tao Group Hospitality serves, supporting causes that are most meaningful to both its team members and diverse group of guests. We work with numerous organizations, paying special attention to causes related to team member health and wellness, youth development, cancer research, and food insecurity. By leveraging our portfolio of brand name venues in our markets worldwide, Tao Group Hospitality Cares enables team members to give back through exclusive volunteer opportunities.
